briefing: Broad market is flat today (NASDAQ and S&P500 both ~0.0%), so this isn't a risk-on day for aggressive deployment, but PL and BRKR show complete multi-signal technical confirmation independent of the index move, so we're filling two of the three open slots with medium conviction while keeping one slot and some cash in reserve.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Idiosyncratic momentum is when an individual stock moves strongly based on its own fundamentals or technical setup, independent of what the broader market is doing. Today's flat index reading didn't stop certain stocks from showing textbook bullish signals (rising MACD, healthy RSI, volume surge), which is why a stock-picking strategy can still find opportunities on an otherwise quiet market day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 個股特有動能（Idiosyncratic Momentum）是指某支股票因自身基本面或技術面因素而出現強勁走勢，與大盤表現無關。儘管今日大盤指數持平，仍有個股展現教科書級的看漲訊號（MACD上升、RSI健康、成交量放大），這正是為何選股策略即使在平淡的市場中仍能發掘投資機會。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially unchanged today, with the S&P 500 and NASDAQ both flat, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to a major catalyst. Individual stocks can still show strong momentum on a flat market day due to company-specific news or sector rotation rather than broad macro drivers. Today's screener showed several healthcare and data-services names with strong technical setups even as the overall market stayed range-bound.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，標普500指數與納斯達克指數均持平，顯示投資人普遍採取觀望態度，未見明顯催化因素。即使大盤持平，個股仍可能因公司特定消息或類股輪動而出現強勁動能，而非受總體經濟因素驅動。今日篩選結果顯示，部分醫療保健與數據服務類股即使在大盤盤整之際仍展現出色的技術面訊號。
